heading: Setup Instructions
intro: A little guide to creating your own painted world.

steps.title: Prepare the Wall
steps.text: For the best results, start with a clean, dry wall. Wipe the surface with a damp cloth to remove dust and allow it to dry completely for a few hours before applying your wall tattoos.

steps.title: Plan Your Composition
steps.text: Before removing the backing paper, carefully cut out the individual tattoos. Arrange them on the wall with small pieces of masking tape. This gives you a chance to play with the placement and see the whole composition before committing.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text:
This part can be a little fiddly, so take your time. Gently peel back approximately 10 cm from the top of the backing paper, taking care not to touch the adhesive too much. Position the top of the tattoo on the wall and lightly press it into place.

Slowly peel away the remaining backing paper while using a clean, soft cloth to smooth the tattoo onto the wall in a gentle downward motion. Work gradually to prevent bubbles or creases. For larger pieces, an extra pair of hands can be very helpful.

steps.title: Handle with Care
steps.text: Some designs have delicate leaves, branches, tails or other fine details. The material is sturdy, but these areas still need careful hands. Slow and gentle is the way to go.

steps.title: Not Quite Right?
steps.text:
Don't worry. If you notice a bubble or crease, or simply decide the placement isn't quite right, gently peel the tattoo back - partly or completely - at an angle and reposition it.

Once you are happy with the placement, gently smooth over the entire tattoo once more to make sure it is firmly adhered to the wall.

steps.title: How to Remove
steps.text:
Start at one corner and slowly peel the tattoo away from the wall at an angle. Take your time, particularly around delicate areas.

Your wall tattoo can be reused. Simply apply it to another suitable wall or carefully place it back onto its original backing paper for storage.

If it has been on the wall for a long time and is a little more difficult to remove, gently warm it with a hairdryer on a low setting. The warmth will help soften the adhesive and make removal easier.

closing: I very much look forward to seeing all your compositions!
